title: M159 · Match thread R1: upcoming matches, carried links and reviews from real games (items 6–8 are R2)
summary: Match Day now lists every upcoming match, not just the next one, and each match is a thread. 'Start a draft', 'Write the plan' and 'Review' from a match open the page already filled in and linked to that match. The server re-checks match and opponent ids as your team's own, and an unknown or foreign link shows a neutral line. Prep steps count only work for this match. A best of 3 reads e.g. 'G1 done · G2 to do · G3 not played'. Earlier work against the same opponent is offered with 'Use for this match' and never counted on its own. Reviews can start from a real game: the review page has a picker that puts games near the match first, with 'Not in the list' for scrims. A team game's match page offers 'Review as a team'. The privacy audit found no stored-data sentence to change. Items 6–8 (series on the match, RSVP, brief share link with migration v17) were not built, per the overseer's early stop rule (weekly limit at 80 %, host outages). They are R2, and nothing of them is half-built. CI is green on the tip cc88702 (run 39638849658: all five jobs, 191/191 e2e, 0 flaky). Final atelier verdict PASS on all five surfaces (upcoming, draft from the match, Bo3 prep, picker, match detail) after its re-check of the cc88702 frames; non-blocking notes are the 3-line draft title at 390 with the long fixture name and no picker row selected in the frame. The round ran far past its 18 h wall because of host starvation and a stop and resume. No migration runs at the next start. Report: REPORT-R1.md.

questions.text: (react) Drafts and plans made before a match was scheduled are offered under 'Earlier work' with a one-tap 'Use for this match'. They are never stamped automatically by date. My suggestion: keep it one-tap and never auto-stamp. OK?

chips.label: Keep one-tap
chips.consequence: Nothing changes. Only a tap links earlier work to a match.

chips.label: Auto-stamp by date
chips.consequence: R2 links unstamped work against the same opponent automatically when it was made in the days before the match.

questions.recommend: Keep one-tap. An automatic link can attach the wrong draft, and one tap is cheap.

questions.text: (react) My R2 defaults: RSVP is stored in a new match_rsvp table, deleted with the match and with the account, and included in the export. The brief share link shows the time, kind, format, opponent team name, roles, and the linked plan's win conditions and role lines. It shows no per-player opponent data. OK?

chips.label: Yes, these defaults

chips.label: Change them

questions.text: (react) The Bo3 'played' rule: a game counts as played when a draft or review is stamped with it, and G1 is always required. Games with no work read 'not played', so a G3 played without any draft or review shows as not played. My suggestion: keep it. OK?

chips.label: Ask after the match
chips.consequence: R2 adds a 'How many games did you play?' choice on the match once it has started, which overrides the rule.

questions.recommend: Keep it. It needs no extra input and is honest about what the app knows. A choice can come later if it misleads in practice.
